summary: Frontend-only E2E + responsive testing of ElevateMe on the public preview URL. Verified mobile (390x844) and desktop (1440x900) landing pages, auth for employer/talent/admin, all 3 new features (Talent Onboarding wizard, Interview Battle Plan, Notifications Center), employer AI role intake, shortlist compare, AI message draft + send, interview schedule/feedback, candidate profile why-match, talent room tabs, talent Career Match/Opportunities/Readiness, admin Command Center/Candidates/Employers/Analytics, plus mobile bottom-nav layout for logged-in pages. All core flows and real-LLM features PASSED. Found 1 medium UX/functional gap (no sign-out on mobile), 1 medium robustness gap (no 404 route -> blank page), and several minor testability/data issues.

ui_bugs.issue: No sign-out / account control on mobile: sidebar (which contains data-testid=logout-btn and the user block) is hidden below md, and the mobile top bar only has the logo + notification bell. A mobile user cannot log out or see which account is active.
No catch-all (*) route. Any unknown/mistyped authenticated URL (e.g. /talent/career-match, /employer/foo) renders a completely blank cream page with no 404/redirect.

ui_bugs.component: Interviews battle-plan modal / Shortlist compare modal
ui_bugs.issue: Modals do not close on Escape. The fixed overlay (Interviews.jsx line ~94) keeps intercepting pointer events, so subsequent clicks on the page (e.g. schedule-*) fail until the user clicks the overlay or the X. Escape-to-close is expected behaviour.

Two NotificationBell instances render simultaneously (mobile top bar + desktop top bar), producing duplicate data-testid="notification-bell" and "notification-count" in the DOM -> Playwright strict-mode violations. Suggest suffixing (notification-bell-mobile / -desktop) or rendering only one.

The mobile hamburger menu links (Sign in / Get Started, Landing.jsx ~line 66) have no data-testid; nav-login / nav-get-started exist only on the hidden desktop nav, so the mobile menu is not test-addressable.

integration_issues.issue: Talent 'Profile' nav points to /talent/onboarding and opens the 5-step wizard with EMPTY fields for an already-onboarded user; publishing from there would overwrite the existing profile with blanks (no prefill from GET /api/talent/onboarding-status).
KPI tiles 'Shortlisted' and 'Interviews' render '—' even though the employer has 2 shortlisted candidates and 5 interviews for that Data Analyst role; role-scoped counts appear unwired.
After sending, the thread does not auto-scroll to the newest message (new message is rendered below the visible scroll area). Also every candidate auto-reply is the identical canned string.

issues: All 4-5 seeded notifications are identical ('Candidate replied / You have a new reply in Messages.') - looks like unvaried demo data
All 5 interview cards are for the same candidate (Priya Shah), reducing demo credibility
Hero match card avatar for 'Priya Shah' is a different person than Priya's photo in the product (find-talent/profile) - inconsistent seed imagery

action_items: Add a mobile account/sign-out affordance (e.g. avatar menu in mobile top bar or 'More' bottom-nav item exposing logout-btn)
Add a catch-all <Route path='*'> 404/redirect in App.js so unknown URLs never render a blank page
Close modals on Escape (battle-plan-modal, compare-modal) and ensure the overlay is unmounted so it cannot intercept clicks
De-duplicate notification-bell/notification-count test ids (render one bell or suffix mobile/desktop)
Prefill the onboarding wizard from existing profile data when talent opens 'Profile', or point Profile to a read-only profile page
Wire role-scoped Shortlisted/Interviews counts in Talent Room (currently '—')
Auto-scroll message thread to latest message after send; add data-testid to landing mobile menu links; vary seeded notifications/interview candidates
critical_code_review_comments: App.js has no fallback route -> silent blank screens on any route typo or stale link
ProductLayout.jsx: logout and user identity are only inside the md:flex sidebar; mobile has no equivalent, i.e. a functional gap not just styling
NAVS.talent maps 'Profile' to the onboarding wizard; the wizard submits a full POST /talent/onboard payload built from empty local state, which is a data-loss risk for existing profiles
Two NotificationBell mounts duplicate ids and duplicate GET /api/notifications polling per page render
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/components/product/ProductLayout.jsx (added data-testid=mobile-nav-* to mobile bottom nav links)

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows pass; 2 medium + 3 low issues)

context_for_next_testing_agent: PASSED and re-verifiable: mobile landing (no horizontal overflow at any scroll depth, hamburger opens menu, hero card stacks), desktop landing (hero/marquee/stats/5 numbered sections, hero-find-talent -> /register, landing-intake-submit -> /register), all 3 role logins land on correct dashboards, notification bell shows unread count + panel items and mark-all-read persists across reload, employer AI role intake (~15s, role-intelligence + availability counts + 6 talent cards), shortlist compare modal (9-row table), ai-draft-btn (377-char LLM draft) + send-message, battle-plan-modal with full AI content (~2.8k chars incl. company/role overview, likely topics, technical + behavioural questions), schedule-* -> 'Scheduled', feedback-btn-* -> decision-strong-hire -> 'Feedback Received', candidate why-this-match, room-tab-* x5, talent career-submit (4 AI role recs), opportunities (3), readiness, admin candidates (18 rows w/ risk badges), employers (3), analytics, mobile logged-in layout (sidebar hidden, bottom nav 5 items now with data-testid=mobile-nav-*, zero horizontal overflow on all employer + admin pages). NOTE: modals only close via X or overlay click - do not press Escape in scripts. NOTE: notification-bell resolves to 2 elements - filter by visibility.
rca_of_the_issue: Mobile logout gap: ProductLayout renders the user block + logout-btn only inside <aside className='hidden md:flex'>, and the md:hidden mobile top bar contains just the logo and NotificationBell, so no logout control exists below the md breakpoint. Blank-page routing: App.js Routes list has no path='*' entry, so React Router matches nothing and renders an empty layout. Modal click-blocking: the battle-plan overlay div (Interviews.jsx ~line 94) has no keydown handler, so Escape leaves the fixed inset-0 overlay mounted and it intercepts pointer events on the underlying buttons.
